ash: PR #18422 (serve/runtime) is blocked on merge — gpu CI keeps failing intermittently on `model-serving-integ`. Need approvals + a targeted rerun. cc @maria @devon :eyes:
ci-bot: buildkite started job 98765 for PR #18422 (pipeline: gpu-lane)
maria: can you paste the failing log? want to check if infra or test flake
devon: fwiw I noticed a short-lived memory spike on shard-3 yesterday that caused a couple OOMs — might be related
ash: paste log below:
```
FAILED tests/integration/test_inference_overload.py::test_kv_cache_timeout
E   AssertionError: Request timed out after 30s
E   Traceback (most recent call last):
E     File "/runner/work/repo/tests/integration/test_inference_overload.py", line 142, in test_kv_cache_timeout
E       assert resp.status == 200
E   asyncio.exceptions.TimeoutError: Task timed out
```
elaine: looks like a timeout against the local mock inference server rather than a pure GPU kernel failure. Two options: add a retry/backoff in the test or mark this test flaky and file a follow-up to fix the mock. For unblock, we should do a targeted rerun of the failing gpu shard (gpu-3)
maria: I can approve after a green targeted rerun. @ci-bot can we rerun only the gpu-3 job, or @ash can you trigger `/bk rerun 98765 --job gpu-3`? :thumbsup:
ci-bot: queued targeted rerun 98766 for job gpu-3 (triggered by ash) — waiting for agent availability
ash: triggered rerun and added label `ci:flaky-skip` to the PR. opened issue #420 to track the mock timing fix. will re-request review once rerun is green. thanks everyone :heart:
